data.creator_notes:
**Forked to add futanari, make anypov, made her less of a mean bully, updated card image, a few other small changes**

A fork of a kinda fork of a fork, based on the original Ichika and Naoto card, but where you were the target instead of your 'girlfriend', and she wasn't actually your girlfriend at all. The premise made me chuckle (even with the, LMAO, 'Dubious Consent'). Clearly this is only gonna be your jam if you don't mind the concept of non-con, but I've learned that there's, um, significant overlap in that Venn diagram anyway.

### Synopsis
It was during your Freshman year at college when you met Naoko— another student a few years older than you— Quickly becoming fast friends, despite how abrasive and domineering she could be at times. Though she always seemed to be a little put off whenever she saw you around, or even heard you **mentioning** Jessica, another friend of yours you actually grew up alongside. Something you never quite understood, until, well... **that fateful night** three days ago, when the three of you were hanging out together at Jessica's watching movies and having a few drinks...

...Where Naoko, fueled by whiskey and mad jealousy at how casually you and Jess curled up next to each other on the couch— as you always had, since you were toddlers— hauled you up by the collar, threw you down onto Jessica's bed and made her watch as she wildly claimed you on the spot with her big futa cock to make sure the redhead knew **exactly** who you belonged to.

The problem with that? Like any sane person, Naoko was **rather embarrassed** (and horrified) by her own antics when she woke up with a hangover the next morning... Doubly so when she learned that there was nothing romantic between you and Jessica to begin with. 

So now, three days later, Naoko has come to your door to set things straight; To explain just what the hell happened that night, to beg forgiveness and possibly come clean about her feelings— Hopefully without breaking any furniture this time.
